title: THEN / NOW
rule: every row is one change made to a product: an earlier state stays grey, a problem has only its measured part struck while its result writes in, a new product says Shipped with its Result, and own projects say what they are with one Detail
description: Ten rows: seven changes to products, then a group of own projects. The page opens on its own product, Snaxx Tech, the live studio site: the first screen holds the real home page over a measured before and after drawn to scale. At load '972 KB' and '28 MB' are struck, '337 KB of pictures. 9.5 MB for the whole site.' writes in, each weight bar shrinks to its new length, and the line runs to the ringed 337 KB. Row 02 is the billing report (16 -> 2), then Bayyinah TV, the care platform (recreation), Read to Feed, Viva Fresh and Design System v2 (with the team). The 'Own projects' group shows Offday (light-theme shifts screen, the ring on a Needs cover shift beside the Off - Vacation mark), OFFBEAT (its drum machine) and FORM (the copper trefoil and its material swatches), each with one plain line, one detail and its public GitHub link where one exists; OFFBEAT and FORM are named concepts, not real brands. The frame sits on a full-height accent field: the paper holds the words, the blue holds the products.
signature: Literata for every sentence and Anton for the labels (THEN, NOW, SHIPPED, RESULT, BUILT, MADE, CONCEPT, DETAIL), the row numbers, the tray and the three diagrams; ink #121212 on paper #F6F5F0, earlier and problem text #57544C (6.9:1), struck part #6B6860 (5.0:1), one accent #2348D8 for the NOW band, the line, the ring and a full-height field from half the column gap to the screen edge (white on accent 7.5:1, caption white at 86%). The diagrams are paper plates on the field: old numbers in ink, new numbers and bars in accent. Desktop: a 1344 px grid, 48 px gutters, the log at the left and a 640 x 560 frame at the right, sticky; the line is accent on paper and white on the field (a hard gradient stop at the field edge). A row becomes current when its top passes 42% of the viewport and settles for 160 ms. A fixed row strikes its measured parts (200 ms), the NOW band wipes in by clip-path (260 ms after 200 ms), the weight bars shrink by transform scaleX (260 ms after 200 ms), then the line draws (180 ms) and the ring fades in (120 ms). Plates cross-fade in 200 ms. Keyboard jumps are instant. Fonts wait at most 300 ms, then metric-matched fallbacks stay for the visit (CLS 0). Phone: the frame pins at the top on an accent band, 4:3, at most 436 px wide, with phone crops and the ring only. Reduced motion: everything is in its end state and nothing moves.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. The frame is still projector's sticky frame beside a scrolling log, and the strike-and-write is year-stack's; the accent field that splits words (paper) from products (blue) is the new part. Seniority drops to 8: the lead is the owner's own studio site and its result is image and site weight, which a peer can call a small task; the 16 -> 2 billing fix is second. Ten rows make the log long; the tray has ten slots. The blue field is loud next to the dark Bayyinah TV and OFFBEAT plates. Offday has no public link, so its row has no link and the tray or arrow keys reach it. On the phone the OFFBEAT crop shows the speaker and its step lights, not the step grid, so it has no ring there. Design System v2 is a team project and its dashboard is not in production; the row says 'with the team' and makes no live claim.
